command:
python3 - <<'PY'
path='mux_test.go'
s=open(path).read()
old='''	// Reset clears mux counters
	DefaultSnmp.Reset()
	reset := DefaultSnmp.Copy()
	if reset.MuxBytesSent != 0 || reset.MuxFramesReceived != 0 {
		t.Fatal("Reset did not clear mux counters")
	}
	_ = atomic.LoadUint64(&after.MuxStreamsOpened)
}'''
new='''	// Reset clears mux counters. Close the sessions and let background
	// goroutines drain before resetting so no in-flight frame races with it.
	s1.Close()
	s2.Close()
	time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
	DefaultSnmp.Reset()
	reset := DefaultSnmp.Copy()
	if reset.MuxBytesSent != 0 || reset.MuxFramesReceived != 0 || reset.MuxStreamsOpened != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("Reset did not clear mux counters: sent=%d recv=%d opened=%d", reset.MuxBytesSent, reset.MuxFramesReceived, reset.MuxStreamsOpened)
	}
	_ = atomic.LoadUint64(&after.MuxStreamsOpened)
}'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(path,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w mux_test.go && timeout 25 go test -race -run 'TestMux' -count=1 -timeout 20s . 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "EXIT: $?"
